description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the values of a metric denoted as $\gamma_C$ across different "Number of Shots" categories. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Number of Shots" and displays discrete numerical categories ordered sequentially from 0 to 4. The vertical value axis is labeled "$\gamma_C$" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2 and corresponding horizontal dotted grid lines. The chart features grouped bars, with two bars per category arranged side-by-side. According to the legend at the top, the left bar in each group, which is blue with a dotted pattern, represents "Incorrect". The right bar in each group is red with a diagonal line pattern; its corresponding text label in the legend is blank, and a third solid grey legend item is also present but not utilized in the chart. All bars are outlined in black to provide visual emphasis. For the "Incorrect" (blue dotted) bars, the values start at approximately 0.24 for 0 shots, decrease to about 0.21 for 1 shot, and remain consistently low at roughly 0.05 for 2, 3, and 4 shots, which are the shortest bars in the chart. The red hatched bars are consistently taller than the blue bars in each group, starting at their highest value of approximately 0.61 for both 0 and 1 shots, then decreasing to about 0.55 for 2 shots, 0.53 for 3 shots, and reaching their lowest value of approximately 0.27 for 4 shots. The categories on the horizontal axis are sorted in ascending numerical order.
